description: This file contains implementation of a fake proof source class used for testing in the QUIC protocol, including methods for handling proof and signature requests, managing pending operations, and interacting with delegate proof sources.

classes.name: FakeProofSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of a proof source used for testing QUIC protocol features.

classes.name: FakeProofSource::GetProofOp
classes.description: Represents a proof request operation within FakeProofSource.

classes.name: FakeProofSource::ComputeSignatureOp
classes.description: Represents a signature computation operation within FakeProofSource.

classes.name: FakeProofSource::PendingOp
classes.description: Base class for pending operations in FakeProofSource.

methods.name: FakeProofSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing the delegate proof source.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Handles proof requests, either directly or by queuing as a pending operation.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Handles signature computation requests, either directly or by queuing as a pending operation.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain from the delegate.

methods.name: GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the ticket crypter, either internal or from delegate.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the fake proof source to queue operations.

methods.name: NumPendingCallbacks
methods.description: Returns the number of pending callback operations.

methods.name: InvokePendingCallback
methods.description: Invokes and removes a pending callback operation by index.
